izzyondroid:dev.agnosticapollo.xlogcatma.name: XLogcatManager
izzyondroid:dev.agnosticapollo.xlogcatma.summary: improve LogcatManager added in Android 13 using Xposed hooks
izzyondroid:dev.agnosticapollo.xlogcatma.description:
XLogcatManager is an Android app to improve LogcatManager added in Android 13 using Xposed hooks. The app requires a rooted device to work.
 Android 13 added LogcatManager which shows a dialog when an app runs logcat command that has READ_LOGS permission before it is allowed to read system wide logs and access is only allowed for the next 60s, after which approval is required again. Access dialog will only be shown if the app is on the top, even if it has a foreground service, and access will be denied for all other background apps automatically. On previous android versions, the app only needed to be granted READ_LOGS permission once with adb or root and then could read logs whenever it wanted.
 The XLogcatManager xposed module was created to allow rooted users to not have to grant adb or root access to apps that shouldn't require it just to read logs by solving LogcatManager design issues and some bugs.
 Features 
 Allows access till next reboot to the app if users selects allow button in the allow access dialog instead of just for the next 60s.
 No 60s timeout to reshow dialog if access was (accidentally) denied by user.
 The dialog will also show for apps with foreground service instead of just top apps.
 Fixes the bugs mentioned in the issuetracker issue based on the solutions provided, but implementation is slightly different in some cases due to method hooking limitations.

A private messenger. No phone number, no email, no account. You are a key
pair generated on your device. On the default route, nobody, including us,
can tie your chats to a real identity, and no one can look you up unless
you claim a public handle.
By default everything travels over Tor. Content is end to end encrypted with
the Signal protocol. Messages travel through relays, sealed so no relay can
read them, and on the default route the relays never learn your IP address
or who you are. No address book upload, ever.
Features:
* Works where Tor is blocked: Kryfo finds a way around it by itself
* Delivery through Nostr relays, so messages reach a phone that was offline
* Groups with photos, files, voice messages, replies, reactions, pins and polls
* Animated stickers that travel as a name, so no picture leaves the phone
* Search across all your chats, kept in the encrypted database
* Timed messages that burn after a set time
* Encrypted local database and encrypted backups
* App lock with PIN or biometrics, a decoy PIN that opens an empty Kryfo, and hidden chats behind a PIN of their own
* Panic wipe that removes everything, including media on disk
* A chat with the person who builds Kryfo, anonymous if you like
* 17 languages
* No analytics or telemetry
Funding: no ads, no investors. It runs on what backers give. Backing is
optional and anonymous, and every feature works the same either way.

fdroid:com.prayer_times.name: Mihrab: The Muslim Companion
fdroid:com.prayer_times.summary: Prayer times matching Diyanet, Kemenag & more to the minute. Quran, dua, qibla.
fdroid:com.prayer_times.description:
Prayer times that match the published timetable to the printed minute: Diyanet’s in Türkiye and worldwide, Islamiska Förbundet’s in Sweden, and those of Morocco’s Ministry of Habous, Algeria’s Ministry of Religious Affairs and Indonesia’s Kemenag.
Each authority’s own method is calculated on your phone and checked, day by day, against its published timetables: 0 of 77.6 million times off the printed minute, last checked 13 November 2026.
Singapore (MUIS), Malaysia (JAKIM) and Türkiye Takvimi are their published tables, used as printed. Everywhere else, times come from AlAdhan or a calculation method you choose, with per-prayer offsets to match your mosque.
Around the prayers, Mihrab is a calm companion for a Muslim’s day: the Quran, and the remembrance in between, with no ads and no account.
PRAY
- Today, the week and the month ahead — shareable as an image or a PDF
- The adhan for each prayer, from built-in recordings or your own, a reminder before it, and a snooze that offers only what the prayer’s time still allows
- A full-screen prayer alert over the lock screen, like an alarm clock, with Stop, Snooze and Log prayer
- Silence the phone for the prayer itself and let it come back on its own, with its own length for Jumu'ah
- A pinned countdown to the next prayer on the lock screen and in the notification shade
- Minimal: only the sky and the countdown on Today, and the day's times a swipe away
- Hanafi or standard Asr, and a minute offset for each prayer
- Qibla compass with signal strength and a cross-check against the sun
- Log each prayer with one tap; the journal keeps the record, the streak and the graph
- Home-screen widgets for the prayer times, today's log, the Hijri date, tasbih and reading
READ AND LISTEN
- The Madinah mushaf, drawn as text from the King Fahd Complex's page fonts and sharp at any size — Warsh, Qalun, Shu'bah and the 15-line IndoPak print beside it
- Tajweed colours, every rule explained — on Hafs and on Warsh
- The word reader: hold a word to hear it read on its own
- A choice of reciters, and for those with word timings, the recited word lit on the page
- Tilawah: surah into surah with the screen off, with a sleep timer
- Translations and classical tafsir, kept for offline reading
- Hifz: what you know by heart, revised on its own cycle; drills, bookmarks, khatmah plans
REMEMBER
- Duas from Hisn al-Muslim, with transliteration and translation
- A tasbih counter for the dhikr after prayer and beyond
- A fasting log for Ramadan and the Sunnah fasts, with reminders
- The Hijri calendar with Ramadan, Eid and Jumu'ah
YOURS
- No ads, no analytics, no trackers, no account
- Sync between your own devices with no account and no server of ours: sealed files in a folder you already keep in sync
- Backup and restore to a file you keep
- Android, iPhone, iPad and Mac, with Arabic and Urdu fully right-to-left
WHAT GOES OVER THE NETWORK
Where your times come from decides what is sent. For Sweden, Diyanet’s places, Morocco, Algeria and Indonesia the times are calculated on the phone and no prayer-time request is made. Elsewhere, AlAdhan (api.aladhan.com) receives your coordinates and the date. Malaysia’s and Singapore’s tables come from Mihrab’s GitHub repository by city, with the authority’s own service as a backup; Türkiye Takvimi by a map tile around you, and namazvakti.com only a city’s number. With automatic location, your city’s name is looked up from your coordinates through OpenStreetMap Nominatim; place search sends what you type. The app checks Mihrab’s GitHub repositories for correction-list and Hijri-date updates, and downloads Quran pages, translations, tafsir and recitation when you ask. Nothing is sent to the developer.
Mihrab is independent. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Diyanet, Islamiska Förbundet, the Moroccan or Algerian ministries, Kemenag, MUIS, JAKIM or Türkiye Takvimi: it matches their published timetables and does not speak for them. Open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

- An SFTP server

flathub:me.njean.shootingpactris.summary: A coop retro game with Tetris, Pacman and shmup gameplay.
flathub:me.njean.shootingpactris.description:
A fun cooperation multiplayer game which mixes universes of
 Pacman, Tetris and shoot’em up (shmup) games.
 The player(s) move around Pacman and the ship. They must
 cooperate to control falling tetris pieces which shoot at the ship,
 while ghosts follow Pacman in a maze!
 It can be played on a same machine with the keyboard or with game pads.
 A network option is also made available.

flathub:net.blockattack.game.name: Block Attack - Rise of the Blocks
flathub:net.blockattack.game.description:
This a puzzle/blockfall game inspired by Nintendo’s Tetris Attack (or “Panel de Pon”) for the
 Super Nintendo. It might seem like any other match-3 style game but it is generally much faster.
 The game requires fast decisions compared to other puzzle games. While you can setup the perfect
 chain it is much more likely that you will construct chains while blocks are still dropping around
 you.
 In addition to traditional game types like endless, time trial and stage clear the game does
 also feature a VS-mode. The VS mode is a dual like you rarely see in a puzzle game.
 The game can be played with keyboard, gamepad or mouse. Keyboard or gamepad are strongly recommended.
 The game allows two players to compete on the same machine.

flathub:net.blockbench.Blockbench.name: Blockbench
flathub:net.blockbench.Blockbench.description:
Blockbench is a free, modern model editor for low-poly and boxy
 models with pixel art textures. Models can be exported into
 standardized formats, to be shared, rendered, 3D-printed, or used
 in game engines. There are also multiple dedicated formats for
 Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition with format-specific features.
 Blockbench features a modern and intuitive UI, plugin support and
 innovative features. It is the industry standard for creating
 custom 3D models for the Minecraft Marketplace.

fedora-packages:cyrus-imapd/cyrus-imapd.description: The Cyrus IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol) server provides access to personal mail, system-wide bulletin boards, news-feeds, calendar and contacts through the IMAP, JMAP, NNTP, CalDAV and CardDAV protocols. A full Cyrus IMAP implementation allows a seamless mail and bulletin board environment to be set up across one or more nodes. It differs from other IMAP server implementations in that it is run on sealed nodes, where users are not normally permitted to log in. The mailbox database is stored in parts of the filesystem that are private to the Cyrus IMAP system. All user access to mail is through software using the IMAP, IMAPS, JMAP, POP3, POP3S, KPOP, CalDAV and/or CardDAV protocols. firefox-addons:3004700.name: Mira Translator – Web Translation & Vocabulary
firefox-addons:3004700.summary: Web, PDF, EPUB & YouTube/X subtitle translation, plus AI translation, sentence analysis, vocabulary tools and cross-device sync.
firefox-addons:3004700.description:
【Translation Services】
Built-in basic translation is available without configuring an API key. Free AI translation is not provided. To use AI features, you must obtain and configure your own API key from a third-party provider. Any related costs are your responsibility.
【Webpage, Document, and Video Translation】
• Immersive webpage translation with customizable page regions.
• PDF translation: Supports text-based PDFs and preserves mathematical formulas and symbols during translation, making it useful for academic papers, technical documents, and other specialized materials. Scanned and image-based PDFs are not supported.
• EPUB translation: Read and translate ebooks in other languages.
• YouTube and X (Twitter) video subtitle translation with bilingual subtitle display.
• Generate and translate subtitles for YouTube and X videos without captions using AI speech recognition.
• YouTube subtitle preview in real time and subtitle downloads. You can also look up and save words directly from subtitles.
【AI Translation and Learning Support】
• Supports compatible AI models and third-party translation services, with customizable API endpoints.
• Context-aware translation: Uses surrounding context to better understand meaning, reduce awkward literal translations, and produce more natural results.
• Custom AI translation styles: Set different translation styles for individual websites. For example, use lively, natural wording for entertainment content and precise, rigorous wording for study materials and professional documents.
• AI sentence analysis: Breaks down sentence structure, grammar, and expressions to help you understand sentences and learn languages.
• AI test generation: Creates personalized exercises and tests based on words saved in your vocabulary list, helping you check your progress and reinforce what you have learned.
• AI image recognition and translation: Send webpage images to your selected AI service to recognize and translate the text they contain.
【Language Learning Tools】
• Vocabulary list: Save words and sentences in various ways and manage your personal learning materials in one place.
• Vocabulary highlighting: Automatically highlight saved words on webpages and in YouTube subtitles.
• Daily review cards: Review words from your vocabulary list with daily cards to reinforce memory.
• Vocabulary tests: Test yourself on words saved in your vocabulary list.
• Glossary: Add specialized terms and fixed translation rules to keep terminology consistent in specialized content.
• Glossary highlighting: Automatically identify and highlight glossary terms on webpages.
【Website Settings and Translation Engines】
• Set global default translation settings to apply across websites.
• Turn automatic translation for the current website on or off directly from the extension popup. Your choice is remembered for each website.
• Manage translation behavior for the current website without manually entering URLs or opening a separate settings page.
• Use the smart selector to choose which webpage elements should be translated.
• Configure translation engines independently for different tasks, including webpage translation, text selection, video subtitles, instant translation, and quick input. Combine different translation services to suit your needs.
【Quick Translation Tools】
• Hover translation: On desktop, hover over a paragraph or word and use a keyboard shortcut to translate it.
• Input field translation: Translate text directly in webpage input fields without copying and pasting.
• Quick translation window: Open a translation window on any webpage with a keyboard shortcut, so you can enter and translate text without leaving the current page.
• Smart caching: Save and reuse translation results for different translation engines to reduce repeated requests. Cached AI translations can also be reused by traditional machine translation engines (NMT).
【Cross-Device and Cross-Browser Sync】
Use your own WebDAV, Google Drive, or OneDrive account to sync your vocabulary list, glossary, and related settings in both directions across devices and supported browsers.
Save words on your computer and sync them to your phone, or save words on your phone and sync them back to your computer for easy access, learning, and review.
Sync data is transferred directly through your selected cloud service using your own account. It does not pass through Mira Translator's servers.
【Privacy】
This extension does not collect your browsing content. API keys are stored locally. AI requests are sent directly from your browser to the third-party provider you choose and do not pass through Mira Translator's servers. The handling of related data is subject to the privacy policy of the selected provider.

apple-macos:6761067019.name: Duplicate Photo Cleaner Tool
apple-macos:6761067019.description:
Cleanup finds the duplicate and similar photos filling your iPhone and helps you clear them in calm daily sessions, with every decision in your hands. On the Mac, the same app shows memory, junk and your iPhone's photos in one window: watch and free RAM with one click, clear junk, and review the iPhone's duplicates on the big screen. One Pro unlock covers both, with Family Sharing.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan — Cleanup analyzes your library on your device and groups exact duplicates, similar shots, screenshots, bursts, and duplicate videos.
2. Review — One group at a time, with a plain explanation of why the photos belong together. The best shot is suggested for you; compare side by side and change your mind at any point.
3. Confirm — See exactly what will be removed before you confirm. Photos move to Recently Deleted, where they stay recoverable for 30 days.
REVIEW ON YOUR MAC
Open Cleanup on your Mac, enter the code your iPhone shows, and go through the same groups on the big screen. Your Mac sees small previews only; the photos stay on the iPhone, and the iPhone asks for your OK before anything is removed.
FREE
• Scan your whole library and see every group
• One cleanup session every day, up to 10 groups
• Best-photo suggestions and side-by-side comparison
• Lifetime progress: photos cleaned and space freed
• Review today's session on your Mac
• On the Mac: live memory monitor and one-click RAM free-up
PRO (optional purchase, one unlock for iPhone and Mac, with Family Sharing)
• Unlimited daily cleanup sessions
• Daily cleanup reminders
• Review your whole library on the Mac
• Junk and cache cleaning on the Mac
• Available as a one-time lifetime purchase or a yearly plan
BUILT FOR TRUST
• You confirm every removal, and Cleanup removes only what you chose
• Recently Deleted keeps everything recoverable for 30 days
• All analysis happens on your device, and your photos stay there
• Clear, honest interface with the price shown before you buy
Keep your library light and your Mac quick, a few minutes at a time.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://photocleanup.byalif.app/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://photocleanup.byalif.app/en/privacy/
